newsitem.title: UK: UK's FTSE 100 jumps 1.7 pct despite rate outlook.
newsitem.headline: UK's FTSE 100 jumps 1.7 pct despite rate outlook.

text.p: UK shares gyrated wildly on Thursday, plunging at the outset but then rebounding to record peaks despite the view that yesterday's budget would lead to sharply higher interest rates.
"We all thought the market would open easier this morning but didn't realise it would be for just five minutes before going through the roof," said the head of market-making at one leading brokerage.
The FTSE 100 index finished up 80.3 points at 4,831.7, eclipsing the previous closing high of 4,783.1 set on June 13, to climb four percent so far this week.
